name: Dolanaar Delivery
summary: In Shadowglen, young travelers carry harvested herbs south to Dolanaar. Porthannius entrusts them with the bundle for Innkeeper Keldamyr.

sections.title: A Bundle from Shadowglen
sections.body: Fresh herbs from Aldrassil are bound for Dolanaar. Porthannius is occupied with matters among the druids of Shadowglen, so he entrusts the bundle to young travelers heading south along the road. They carry it to Innkeeper Keldamyr.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hearth
sections.body: The parcel brings you to Dolanaar's inn, where Keldamyr receives it with gratitude. The inn offers weary travelers rest, peace of mind, and sanctuary before they venture deeper into Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is inside the Dolanaar Delivery?
faq.answer: The package holds fresh herbs gathered in Shadowglen for Innkeeper Keldamyr and the patrons of Dolanaar's inn.
Porthannius, an elf tending to business with the druids in Shadowglen, prepares the bundle but cannot spare time to travel south himself.

faq.q: Who receives the package in Dolanaar?
aliases: who do i bring the herbs to
faq.answer: Innkeeper Keldamyr receives the package at the communal inn in the heart of Dolanaar.

faq.q: Why couldn't Porthannius deliver the parcel himself?
faq.answer: Porthannius has urgent, unfinished business with the druids around Aldrassil, so he seeks a traveler heading south along the forest road.

angles.text: Herbs gathered around Aldrassil meet steady demand as Teldrassil's outlying settlements stock their supplies.
As a young kaldorei, carrying the package marks a rite of passage beyond Shadowglen's protective boughs and into the wider realm.
